title: GIG-3189: JSON Token Anonymization And Skip Missing Columns
description: Adds JSON path rewrite, token clearing, consistent replacements, and continue-on-failure so postmaclone clones cannot keep live secrets or abort on a missing column.

test_plan.description: Unit tests cover JSON rewrite, clear, emailOrName, consistent mapping, and skip-invalid-JSON
Missing columns and invalid JSON do not abort a non-strict run
steps: Configure a table with a missing column and a JSON column containing invalid JSON
Confirm the run finishes, the missing column is warned, and the invalid JSON cell is {}

test_plan.description: Empty JSON objects keep object shape after rewrite
steps: Confirm a payload with empty objects still encodes as {} not []

test_plan.description: uniqueEmailOrName produces an email or name, not NULL
steps: Confirm email-valued and name-valued cells both get non-null replacements

test_plan.description: MySQL SQL emit escapes backslashes in JSON literals
steps: Confirm JSON backslashes are doubled in the MySQL quoted literal
